content.comment_body: I'm working on a project that needs to transmit emergency signals to a mobile phone. The choice of GSM module isn't clear for the new [product_name]. In this post, I'm hoping to learn about possible ways to use modules with [product_name]. Regards, [user_name].

Hello, you can use GSM modems. The modem should have digital inputs, and you can configure it to send an SMS to a mobile phone when a positive signal is present on one of those inputs. Many such modems are available on the market. For example, see [url]. Since [product_name] (model [article_no]) lacks a serial interface, this is the only solution I know. Hope this information is helpful.
Hello, I think this will be a good solution for my water protection system project.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to set up emergency SMS notifications using [product_name], but is unsure about compatible GSM module options due to the absence of direct serial interfaces. Participants recommend using third-party GSM modems with digital inputs, highlighting limited direct integration and pointing out a lack of clear support for GSM connectivity with [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a straightforward method to connect [product_name] to GSM modules for automatic emergency SMS messages, ideally with well-documented and supported hardware options.
